metadata.description: A personal Claude Code plugin library.

plugins.name: executive-assistant
plugins.description: Configurable executive assistant for productivity workflow automation. Gmail and Calendar via Google Workspace MCP, plus Slack, Jira, Linear, and markdown notes in a folder you configure.

plugins.name: voice-replies
plugins.description: Reads the main agent's replies aloud, rewritten for speech, with Kokoro on the GPU and a compact voice panel above the prompt.

plugins.name: session-manager
plugins.description: Reviews your open Claude sessions and tells you which are stale, which wait on you, and which are done but not archived. Type /manager for a to-do list with one next step per session, then bulk archive stale ones with their worktrees.

plugins.name: session-brief
plugins.description: Shows a brief above the prompt: how the session started, where it left off, next steps and what you should know. Renames the session to say what the work is.
